rules.coverage_text: Rental properties with five or more units are covered by Jersey City rent control.

exemptions.quote: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)

rules.quote: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.requirement: Jersey City's Rent Control Ordinance does not apply to properties with 1-4 units. The Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations administers and enforces the ordinance.
rules.title: Rent control exemption for 1-4 unit properties
